0.2.0.en:
Automatic reconnect (with backoff) when the connection to the projector is lost
Robust parsing of replies split or merged by TCP, timeout for unanswered commands
No more duplicate commands in the queue, user commands are sent before pending polls
Fixed poll interval setting in the admin UI (was stored under a wrong key)
Fixed command name for tracking (TRACKING)
Fixed state changes for instance numbers >= 10
Removed unused lib/tools.js and the invalid npm script "publish"
Requires Node.js >= 20, js-controller >= 6.0.11 and admin >= 7.6.17
Added unit tests for the protocol handling, fixed test and lint setup
Existing objects are updated on start; added min/max/unit, corrected roles
Invalid or out-of-range values are no longer sent to the projector
Removed old materialize admin files
Documented configuration and states in the README
